about: The look capture's list (S105, BUILD_VIII row 105; e2e/look.spec.ts, npm --prefix frontend run look): frames of the Galaxy view to set beside the goal pictures (tools/goal_sheet.py), written as PNGs into GALAXYGEN_LOOK_DIR (default docs/goals/look/, gitignored). Never compared with anything: a working tool for the illustrative look's tuning, not a test. GALAXYGEN_LOOK_ONLY (comma-separated names) takes a subset; GALAXYGEN_LOOK_COMBINATION (a copy box's JSON, pasted) adds one capture named GALAXYGEN_LOOK_NAME (default 'combination') at that combination on its template and look.

fields.name: The PNG's name (without .png): lower-case letters, digits, underscores and hyphens.
fields.template: The template, by its name in /api/templates; chosen in the switcher. The camera is the template's own stand (times the framing under the illustrative look).
fields.look: physical or illustrative: stored as the browser's look before the page loads.
fields.combination: Optional: Tuning values over the look's defaults for the template, as a copy box lists them (an 'ill' object for the illustrative parameters). Absent: the look's defaults, whatever the browser held.
fields.exposure: Optional: the exposure slider's stops (else the template's default).
fields.viewport: Optional: the canvas side, px (1024 by default).
fields.leastLit: Optional (S108): the least share of the central square that must be lit, in place of 0.45, for a frame mostly sky (edge-on); at least 0.02, so a black frame still fails.
